Home.heroTitle: Wake up to nature on Mors
Home.heroSubtitle:
Real camping in Sejerslev,
surrounded by the Limfjord and beautiful nature
Home.introText: Nestled in the quiet village of Sejerslev on the island of Mors, our campsite offers a genuine escape into Danish nature. Whether you come for a weekend or a full holiday, you'll find space to breathe, explore, and truly relax.
Home.feature1Description: Campsites, motorhome pitches, cozy cottages, etc. — find the perfect way to relax.
Home.feature2Description: No noise, no stress — just birdsong, campfire cosiness, and time to be together. Here, nature sets the pace.
Home.feature3Description: Minutes from Hanklit's 55-million-year-old cliffs, the Molergraven, Skaerbaek Cliff, and the peaceful shores of the Limfjord.
Home.feature4Description: Dogs are welcome and stay for free. We have a dedicated dog run so your four-legged friend can enjoy the holiday too.
Home.altSection1Title: The perfect base for exploring Mors
Home.altSection1Text: From our campsite, you're just a short drive or bike ride from everything the island has to offer — Skaargaard, Fossil and Mill Museum, Nykobing Mors, Museum Mors, and the impressive cliffs at Hanklit and Skaerbaek.
Home.altSection2Text: Fresh air, unhurried time, and room to breathe deeply. At Camping Slap Af, we believe the best holidays are the ones where you have time to truly relax.
Home.testimonialComingSoonText: We've just reopened under a new name — the first guest reviews will appear here soon.
Home.ctaDescription: Book your spot at Camping Slap Af and experience the best of Mors. Season open until October 18, 2026.

About.title: About Camping Slap Af
About.subtitle: A place where nature sets the pace
About.storyText1: We are Angela and Jeroen. In 2019, Jeroen was diagnosed with cancer, but fortunately, he has since recovered. Our mindset did change, though. We'd always worked hard for a boss, but now it was time to be our own bosses. We took the plunge to breathe new life into the once-glorious Gerlis Campground on Mors.
About.storyText2: We'd always worked under pressure, but we found the time to change course. A vacation should have a relaxed vibe. That's why we've chose a single price for the entire season. A low price. People work all year round for their wages and want to enjoy a vacation. We believe it's better to pay less for your stay so you can enjoy what the area has to offer, like an ice cream, a museum, or whatever you'd like to do.
About.renewalText1: After we bought the campground in January 2026, we first tackled the house so that, once the snow melted, we could turn to the campground itself. The common area, showers, and cabins were upgraded; the oil tank was removed and a modern heat pump was installed. It's our way of taking a step toward a cleaner environment.
About.renewalText2: We're also focusing on your own vegetable garden. Several blackberry bushes already grow on the property, and a vegetable garden has been planted where you can pick your own vegetables.
About.locationText1: From here, it's a great starting point to explore North Mors. Take a walk to the Limfjord or Skargaard. Go hiking, water skiing, or fishing, and a smoker is available for preparing your own catch.
About.locationText2: What really stands out here is the wild nature. And if you get up early, you have a good chance of seeing a roe deer standing right in front of your tent.
About.value1Description: We take care of the nature around us and encourage our guests to enjoy it with respect.
About.value2Description: We believe camping is about togetherness — with family, with friends and with new acquaintances.
About.value3Description: No unnecessary distractions. Just you, nature and a great experience.

Accommodation.title: Accommodation
Accommodation.subtitle: Find the perfect accommodation for your stay at Camping Slap Af
Accommodation.campsiteDescription: Spacious campsites with soft grass and good distance to neighbours. Electricity available.
Accommodation.camperDescription: Level motorhome pitches with electrical connection and water access nearby. Suitable for motorhomes and caravans of all sizes.
Accommodation.cottageDescription: Cozy cabin with basic facilities — multiple sizes, for 2–4 people. Priced per cabin, regardless of guest count.
Accommodation.fieldDescription: Open camping field with space for tents and smaller camping equipment. Great for groups and scouts.
Accommodation.seasonalDescription: Seasonal pitch for the full season. Electricity billed separately by consumption. Perfect if you want your own fixed spot all summer.
Accommodation.cottageFlat: Flat rate regardless of number of guests
Accommodation.facilitiesDescription: All guests have access to our shared facilities.
Accommodation.breadNote: Order fresh bread before 4 PM the day before — it's ready for you the next morning.
Accommodation.dogFriendlyText: Dogs are welcome and stay for free. They must be kept on a leash on site. Maximum 3 dogs (more by arrangement). We have a dedicated dog run.

Activities.title: Activities
Activities.subtitle: There is plenty to experience — both on site and in the surrounding area
Activities.activity1Description: Small playground for the little ones with room to play and explore.
Activities.activity2Description: Pick fresh herbs and vegetables from our shared vegetable garden.
Activities.activity3Description: Gather the family around the fire pit in the evening. We provide the firewood.
Activities.activity4Description: Fenced dog run where your dog can run free and play off-leash.
Activities.activity5Description: Fishing in the Limfjord right by the site — perfect for a relaxed day by the water.
Activities.activity6Description: Grills available for guests to barbecue and enjoy a meal outdoors together.
Activities.nearby1Description: Impressive Moler cliffs with fossils from 55 million years ago. Just a few kilometres from the site.
Activities.nearby2Description: Dramatic coastal cliff with views over the Limfjord and fascinating geological layers.
Activities.nearby3Description: Visit the beautiful Skaargaard and experience the history and culture of Mors up close.
Activities.nearby4Description: Explore Mors' unique fossils and historic mills at this fascinating museum.
Activities.nearby5Description: A charming little marina on the Limfjord, surrounded by beautiful nature.
Activities.nearby6Description: The island's charming main town with shops, restaurants, harbour, and cultural life.
Activities.nearby7Description: Dive into Mors' fascinating natural and cultural history at this well-maintained museum.
Activities.nearby8Description: Classic Danish specialties in a cozy setting by the Feggesund ferry landing.
